Context: None

Question: Which one of the following statements is true:

Options: 
A. Protons and neutrons possess orbital angular momentum only.
B. Protons and neutrons possess spin angular momentum only.
C. Protons possess orbital angular momentum only, neutrons possess spin angular momentum only.
D. Protons and neutrons have orbital and spin angular momentum.
E. Neutrons and protons possess both orbital and spin angular momentum.
F. Neutrons possess orbital angular momentum only, protons possess both orbital and spin angular momentum.
G. Protons and neutrons possess neither orbital nor spin angular momentum.
H. Neutrons have orbital and spin angular momentum, protons have spin angular momentum only.
I. Protons possess spin angular momentum only, neutrons possess orbital angular momentum only.
J. Protons have orbital and spin angular momentum, neutrons have spin angular momentum.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
